newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM TAKES 35TH PLACE IN WORLD CORRUPTION POLL.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM TAKES 35TH PLACE IN WORLD CORRUPTION POLL.

text.p: Belgium takes 35th place in Transparency International's commercial corruption rankings, published by the Wall Street Journal Europe on Friday.
The ranking is based on the level of corruption in a country perceived by employees of multinational firms and institutions.
The most corrupt country was Nigeria, followed by Pakistan and Kenya.

Among European Union member countries, Italy was in 21st place, Spain in 23rd, Portugal in 33rd and France in 36th. The U.S. was in 40th place. Least corrupt country in the list was New Zealand, at 54th place.
